description: Tuned CatBoost on exp009 features. exp014's CatBoost (30.45) was a 4.13 RMSE win using default-ish params — there is likely more to squeeze with depth 10, smaller learning rate, more iterations, and tuned regularization.
implementation_notes: Use the EXACT exp014 feature matrix (exp009 features minus the target-encoded geology label, geology label passed as cat_features).

CatBoost tuned params: task_type='GPU', iterations=12000, learning_rate=0.03, depth=10, l2_leaf_reg=3.0, bagging_temperature=0.5, random_strength=1.0, random_seed=42, od_type='Iter', od_wait=300, eval_metric='RMSE', loss_function='RMSE', grow_policy='SymmetricTree' (default).
5-fold GroupKFold by well_id. Save OOF and test predictions in original CSV row order.
Compare to exp014 (30.454). Even a 0.2-0.5 improvement matters.
